questions.questionText: Rondedzero (400–450 mazwi): Nyora rondedzero pamusoro penyaya inoti: "Kukosha kwekurima kwakanaka (Pfumvudza) mukurwisa nzara mumaruwa eZimbabwe." [30 marks]
questions.explanation: Nhanganyaya: Tsanangura dambudziko renzara nekushanduka kwemamiriro ekunze [4]. Muviri: Kucherwa kwemakomba, kufukidza ivhu nemashanga, kushandisa fetiraiza/mupfudze pamwero wakakodzera, uye kuchengetedza hunyoro [18]. Mhedziso nemashoko akapfuma etsumo/madimikira nezviperengo zvakanaka [8]. Total: [30 marks].

questions.questionText: Tsamba yepamutemo: Nyora tsamba kuna Kanzura wedunhu renyu uchikumbira kuti mugwagwa unopinda pachikoro chenyu ugadziriswe mvura isati yatanga. [20 marks]
questions.explanation: Zvikamu zvinotariswa: Kero mbiri nezuva [4]; Mhoroso yepamutemo nemuoro wenyaya wakaturikwa (RE: KUKUMBIRA KUGADZIRISWA KWEMUGWAGWA) [3]; Tsananguro yenjodzi kuvana nevatakuri uye chikumbiro chine rukudzo [9]; Mhedziso "Ndini wenyu akatendeka" nezita rizere [4]. Total: [20 marks].

questions.questionText:
Pfupiso (Summary): Verenga ndima pamusoro pekuchengetedza sango: "Masango anopa huni, michero yemhando dzakawanda, mishonga yechivanhu, uye anodzivirira kukukurwa kwevhu. Zvisinei, kutemwa kwemiti zvisina tsarukano kuri kukonzera kushomeka kwemvura mumatsime nekupinduka kwemamiriro ekunze."
Pfupikisa kukosha kwemasango nematambudziko okwatemwa mumazwi asingadariki 35. [10 marks]
questions.explanation: Masango anopa huni, michero, mishonga, uye anodzivirira kukukurwa kwevhu [5]. Kutemwa kwemiti zvisina tsarukano kunokonzera kushomeka kwemvura mumatsime nekushanduka kwemamiriro ekunze [5]. Total: [10 marks].

questions.questionText:
Dudziramutauro: Tsanangura zvinoreva uye ipa muenzaniso mumwe chete wezvinhu zvinotevera muChiShona:
(a) Nyaudzosingwi [2 marks]
(b) Dimikira [2 marks]
(c) Mutupo [2 marks]
questions.explanation: (a) Nyaudzosingwi izwi rinoratidza chiito, kurira, kana chimiro (muenzaniso: kunyarara kuti zii) [2]. (b) Dimikira mutauro wakavharika unotakura pfungwa yakadzika (muenzaniso: kubata kumeso — kunyengera) [2]. (c) Mutupo chiratidzo cherudzi nemhuri chinobatanidza hama (muenzaniso: Mhofu, Shumba, Soko) [2].

questions.questionText: Tsanangura mabasa mana akakosha anotarisirwa kuitwa namadzishe kana masabhuku mukuchengetedza unhu nemagariroakanaka munharaunda. [8 marks]
questions.explanation: 1. Kutonga mhosva diki mudare redunhu nerunyararo [2]. 2. Kuchengetedza tsika dzakaita sechisi nemikwerera [2]. 3. Kurambidza kuparadzwa kwemasango nemasowe [2]. 4. Kukurudzira rubatsiro kunherera nechembere (Zunde raMambo) [2].

questions.questionText: Shanduro (Translation from English to ChiShona): Shandura chirevo ichi uchiisa muChiShona chakanaka: "Education is the key to success, so young learners must avoid drug abuse and respect their elders." [6 marks]
questions.explanation: Dzidzo ndiyo kiyi yekubudirira, saka vadzidzi vechidiki vanofanira kunzvenga kushandisa zvinodhaka zvisiri pamutemo uye kuremekedza vakuru vavo [6 marks].

questions.questionText:
Nzwisiso yeNhetembo: Verenga mutsara unoti: "Mvura yakanaya ikatamba pamusoro pemashizha sevasikana pamuchato."
(a) Ndechipi chidavado chemutauro chashandiswa? [1 mark]
(b) Tsanangura mufananidzo uri kubuda mundima iyi. [3 marks]
questions.explanation: (a) Fananidzo (Simile) pamwe neKuitisa munhu (Personification: mvura ichitamba) [1]. (b) Mufananidzo unotaridza mafaro norunako rwemvura ichisvetuka pamashizha akasvibira zvinoita kunge vanhu vari kupembera pamuchato [3].

questions.questionText:
Isa mazwi anotevera muuzhinji uye nyora zvirevo chizere neizwi rega rega:
(a) rwendo [2 marks]
(b) sadza / bhora [2 marks]
(c) mukadzi [2 marks]
questions.explanation: (a) rwendo -> nzendo (Nzendo dzakareba dzanetsa) [2]. (b) bhora -> mabhora (Vana vatamba nemabhora matsva) [2]. (c) mukadzi -> vakadzi (Vakadzi vakarima minda yavo) [2].

questions.questionText: Hurukuro (Dialogue): Nyora hurukuro pakati pevabereki vaviri vachikurukura nezvekuoma kana kukosha kwekudzidzisa vanasikana zveSayenzi neTekinoroji. [15 marks]
questions.explanation: Hurongwa: Mazita evatauri kuruboshwe ane makoroni; pfungwa dzakadzama dzinopikisa tsumo dzechinyakare dzichiratidza kuti vasikana vanokwanisa kuva vanachiremba nevagadziri vecomputers; mutauro wemudare une unhu [15 marks].

questions.questionText:
Dudzira tsumo mbiri dzinotevera uye upe chiitiko chinodzitsigira:
(a) "Rume rimwe harikombi churu." [3 marks]
(b) "Chaitemura chava kuseva." [3 marks]
questions.explanation: (a) Munhu mumwe chete haakwanisi kuita basa guru pasina rubatsiro rwamwe (somuenzaniso nhimbe yekukohwa) [3]. (b) Munhu aimbotambura kana kufurufuka zvino ave kugara zvakanaka (somuenzaniso munhu akazowirwa nerombo rakanaka pabasa) [3].
